purpose: Summarize relative regional compatibility within each already-generated chronology scenario without converting the deterministic scenario envelope into a posterior probability.
ranking_direction: larger cosine is more concordant with the frozen Azami orientation-environment vector within that chronology scenario
summaries: rank-1 frequency across the 94 deterministic chronology scenarios
median and quantile rank by region
paired cosine differences for all six region pairs
fraction of chronology scenarios with positive paired difference
minimum, q05, median, q95 and maximum paired difference

interpretation_rule.scenario_dominant: A region is scenario-dominant only if it is rank 1 in at least 75% of the 94 chronology scenarios and its paired cosine difference is positive in at least 75% of scenarios against every other region.
interpretation_rule.relative_ordering_present_but_not_domina: At least one region has the best median rank or positive majority pairwise ordering, but the scenario-dominant rule is not met.
interpretation_rule.no_stable_regional_ordering: No region has a positive majority pairwise ordering against all other regions.

claim_boundary: Rank frequencies are fractions of a deterministic sensitivity grid, not posterior probabilities of ancestral area.
A higher regional rank does not identify the true ancestral location or transition-time environment.
This analysis does not change the frozen origin-trajectory classification; it only exposes ordering within its uncertainty envelope.
Regions differ in spatial extent and cell count, so rankings describe the declared regional summaries rather than area-normalized ancestral probabilities.
